summary: Feed s062_single is degraded due to 27.1% duplicate packets (1150/4238 exceeds 5% threshold). All other checks (one-way, drops, overload, VLAN, encryption) are healthy.

findings.root_cause: Packet broker is aggregating multiple SPAN/mirror or TAP feeds carrying the same packets without deduplication - same packet arriving on two ingress ports forwarded to single APM egress port.
findings.impact_on_tool: APM will double-count transactions and inflate throughput/latency metrics by ~27%, waste 10G tool capacity/storage, and generate false performance alerts while obscuring true application performance.

recommended_fix.why: Enable packet-broker deduplication to drop identical packets within dedup window before delivery to APM, restoring accurate transaction counts and freeing ~27% bandwidth for real traffic.
